content.short: Ember Sword is a free-to-play blockchain MMORPG on Mantle where players own land, items, and cosmetics as real NFT assets.
content.description: Ember Sword is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game built on blockchain technology that aims to compete with traditional AAA MMORPGs while giving players true ownership of their in-game assets. Players can own land plots (LAND NFTs) within the game's world, earning from the economic activity that takes place on their territory. The game features a classless progression system, a player-driven economy, and cosmetic NFTs with real on-chain value. Ember Sword is deployed on Mantle as part of its blockchain infrastructure layer.
